releaseNotes: Ribbon split into two tabs: Elmashad-P6 (project, analysis, WBS & reports, settings) and Elmashad-ExcelTool (data cleanup) - each tool now lives where you expect it.

New Quick Clean tool on the ExcelTool tab: select messy cells, preview exactly what would change (trim spaces, collapse repeated spaces, remove hidden/invisible characters, normalize line breaks, clean non-breaking spaces, convert text numbers), then apply. Formula cells are always protected and are never modified, and every apply can be undone in the same session.

Complete report visual reset: reports now ship three complete, isolated styles - P6 Classic (default, light planner look), Elmashad Light and Elmashad Dark - switched atomically from the Style button; app theme can no longer leak into reports. Print always uses the light palette.

Chart fixes: the S-curve now shows its full date axis (a tick-step bug previously collapsed it to a single date label), curves re-measure their pane before drawing, and data labels no longer overlap where curves cross.
Gantt row height restored - a lost style token had compressed every report gantt row so all bars stacked into one dense band.
Updates window rebuilt responsive: it fills the window at any size, shows package provenance (published date, size, SHA-256) with the release notes, and keeps the footer actions visible.
Window shell: the title-bar close button is now perfectly centered and aligned at all DPI settings.
All release gates re-run: the exact built installer was executed on a fresh machine against an offline update endpoint, and the published bytes were re-downloaded and executed after publishing.
